Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，或许，可以，请你帮个忙……吗……
Content.LocalizedString: Um, Appraiser… could you maybe… help me with something…?

Content.SourceString: 今天送货的时候，不小心把自己新买的衣服落在半角街了(；′⌒`)
Content.LocalizedString: I accidentally left my new clothes on Hankaku Street when I was making deliveries today… (；′⌒`)

Content.SourceString: 本来打算先把新衣服送洗的，结果突然来了急单，一不小心就把衣服落在那了……
Content.LocalizedString: I was planning to take my new clothes to the cleaners, but then a rush order came in and I accidentally left them there…

Content.SourceString: 我怕被别人拿走，但现在又在别的地方，一时间赶不回来……
Content.LocalizedString: I'm worried someone might take them, but I'm stuck somewhere else right now and can't get back in time…

Content.SourceString: 因为半角街就在伊波恩附近嘛……所以就想着，如果你在伊波恩的话，可以先帮我取一下吗（对手指.jpg）
Content.LocalizedString: Since Hankaku Street is right near Eibon… I was thinking, if you're nearby, could you maybe grab them for me? [does_the_finger-pointing_thing.jpg]

OptionText.LocalizedString: Would you like me to deliver it for you?

Content.LocalizedString: Sure, I'll head over there now.
Would you like me to deliver it for you?

Content.SourceString: 谢谢你！我一会儿就来取！是Q3的袋子，就放在门口。
Content.LocalizedString: Thank you so much! I'll come pick it up in a bit! It's in a Q³ shopping bag, just left by the door.

Content.SourceString: 不用不用，我一会儿就过来取！是Q3的袋子，就放在门口。谢谢你！
Content.LocalizedString: No no, that's okay! I'll come pick it up myself in a bit! It's in a Q³ shopping bag by the door. Thank you so much!

Content.SourceString: 谢谢你！我一会儿就来取！是Q3的袋子，就放在门口。
Content.LocalizedString: Thank you so much! I'll come pick it up in a bit! It's in a Q³ shopping bag, just left by the door.

Content.SourceString: 不用不用，我一会儿就过来取！是Q3的袋子，就放在门口。谢谢你！
Content.LocalizedString: No no, that's okay! I'll come pick it up myself in a bit! It's in a Q³ shopping bag by the door. Thank you so much!

Content.LocalizedString: Hey Appraiser, wanna grab some food at Clicky? I still owe you a meal! OwO

Content.SourceString: 火炬木大道上那家咔叽玛见！
Content.LocalizedString: Meet me at Clicky on Torchwood Avenue!

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，什么时候再有空出来玩呀| ·ω· ` )
Content.LocalizedString: Hey Appraiser, when will you be free to hang out again? | ·ω· ` )

Content.SourceString: 想去未闻浦那边的露营地，但自己一个人太无聊了，所以来问问你~
Content.LocalizedString: I wanna hit up the camping grounds at Unheard Shores, but going solo is like, totally dull, so I wanted to ask if you'd come with me!

Content.SourceString: 我随时都可以~定个时间？
Content.LocalizedString: I'm good whenever! Wanna pick a time?

Content.SourceString: 你不是还有快递员的工作吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Don't you still have your courier job?

Content.SourceString: 有工作也有休息日啊！讨伐恶龙的勇者要是从头到尾都在和恶龙打架，就太无聊了！
Content.LocalizedString: Gotta balance work and chill, ya know? A dragon-slaying queen can't hit the dragons 24/7—that'd be, like, totally dull!
Grind fierce, chill fabulous—that's the real drip!

Content.SourceString: 下午两点？不过，到时候要是下雨了的话，就等下一个晴天吧！
Content.LocalizedString: How about 2 in the afternoon? If it happens to rain, we'll just wait for the next sunny day!

Content.SourceString: 下午两点？不过，到时候要是下雨了的话，就等下一个晴天吧！
Content.LocalizedString: How about 2 in the afternoon? If it happens to rain, we'll just wait for the next sunny day!

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师你看你看，这个好帅啊！
Content.LocalizedString: Hey hey, Appraiser, look at this! So cool!!

Content.SourceString: （视频链接：<Blue>路过StarSign听见惊喜！三人学生乐队组合！</>）
Content.LocalizedString: (video link: <Blue>Passing by StarSign & caught THIS?! Surprise performance by student band trio!</>)

Content.SourceString: 好像是以前演出过的乐队欸！虽然在最后排又拍得太晃了……但光听演奏就觉得好有水平哦！
Content.LocalizedString: I think it's one of the bands that's played there before! The video's super shaky and I was way in the back, but their playing? 🔥🔥🔥

Content.SourceString: 我之前都没意识到台下有这么乱呢……看来是我太沉浸其中了！
Content.LocalizedString: I didn't realize it was that chaotic in the crowd lol… I must've been way too into it 🤯

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师你看这个！这个呗主的的吉他教学很完整诶！
Content.LocalizedString: Look what I found!! This guitar tutorial is super detailed!!

Content.LocalizedString: (video link: <Blue>Guitar Basics Even Danzaburou Can Understand!</>)

Content.SourceString: 下面的评价也都很好，很适合新手入门用，好决定了，先加入我的收藏夹！
Content.LocalizedString: The comments are great too, looks like it's perfect for newbies like me! Bookmarked immediately!!

Content.SourceString: 呜哇看了下，居然不知道什么时候已经收藏过了……
Content.LocalizedString: …Wait a sec I already bookmarked it ages ago and totally forgot.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师鉴定师我又找到了这个！是给鼓手的入门教程，感觉鉴定师可以用得上！
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser!! Found another one!! This time it's a starter guide for drums! You might be able to use it!!

Content.SourceString: （视频链接：<Blue>爆裂鼓手的养成方式！Ep1</>）
哼哼，过段时间一定要让明音姐大吃一惊！
Content.LocalizedString: Hehehe, I'm totally gonna blow Akane's mind soon!

Content.SourceString: 天才吉他少女哈尼娅的进化速度，哼哼……
Content.LocalizedString: Guitar prodigy Haniel's evolution is unstoppable…

Content.SourceString: 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！
明天下午，哦不对，今天下午StarSign见哦~
Content.LocalizedString: See you tomorrow afternoon—no wait, technically today—at StarSign! Don't forget. ✨

Content.SourceString: 哼哼，没什么能难住哈尼娅！
Content.LocalizedString: Hehe, nothing's too difficult for Haniel!
Wait, I think there's still a problem…

Content.SourceString: 呼叫支援！急需鉴定师支援！
Content.LocalizedString: Calling for backup! Appraiser assistance needed!
Ah, no no no! That's wrong!
I'll treat u to afternoon tea.

Content.SourceString: 在的在的，鉴定师有什么事吗？
在在在，我送完这单就来！
Content.LocalizedString: Yes! I'm here! I'll come right after I finish this delivery!
Did ur phone catch a virus?

Content.SourceString: 手机放在口袋里，忘记锁屏了
Content.LocalizedString: I left my phone unlocked in my pocket.
I must have tapped it by accident.

Content.SourceString: 怎么发出去这么多消息。
Content.LocalizedString: How did I manage to send so many messages?

Content.SourceString: 吓死我了，我还以为发生了什么大事。
Content.LocalizedString: Omg u scared me! I thought something terrible happened.

Content.SourceString: 一向沉稳的鉴定师居然发了这么多消息。
Content.LocalizedString: U would never spam messages like that unless ur in trouble!

Content.SourceString: 总之没事就好，没事就是好事。
Content.LocalizedString: Anyway glad it's nothing! No news = Good news!

Content.SourceString: 不过我已经快到伊波恩了。
Content.LocalizedString: But I'm almost at Eibon now.

Content.SourceString: 那作为赔偿，我请哈尼娅吃饭吧。
Content.LocalizedString: As an apology, dinner's on me.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，能不能拜托你帮个忙？
Content.LocalizedString: Hey, could u do me a favor?

OptionText.LocalizedString: Tell me what it is first.

Content.LocalizedString: Tell me what it is first

Content.SourceString: 今晚八点，《特工Z世代》的新周边就要开售了。
Content.LocalizedString: The new "Gen Z" merch drops tonight at 8!

Content.SourceString: 但是每个账号限购十份，我真的很想吃复数。
Content.LocalizedString: But each account is limited to 10, and I really wanna get more!

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师能帮我抢几份吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Could u help me snag a few packs, Appraiser?

Content.SourceString: 就是很多很多个一样的制品。
Content.LocalizedString: Ya know, like getting tons of the same exact item!

Content.SourceString: 因为一模一样的东西整整齐齐地摆出来的那一刻真得很爽！
Content.LocalizedString: Cuz there's just something so satisfying about lining up a bunch of identical items all neat and perfect!

Content.SourceString: 三个角色每样都三份就可以了。
Content.LocalizedString: Just three copies of each character, that's all I need!

Content.SourceString: 三个角色每样都三份就可以了。
Content.LocalizedString: Just three copies of each character, that's all I need!

Content.SourceString: <Blue>《特工Z世代》新形象今日公开！详情请戳……</>
Content.LocalizedString: <Blue>New "Gen Z" character designs revealed today! Press for details…</>

OptionText.LocalizedString: I didn't recognize you at first…
The art style looks a bit weird?

Content.LocalizedString: I didn't recognize you at first…
The art style looks a bit weird?

Content.SourceString: 连鉴定师都看出来了吗……
啊啊啊啊啊啊自从宣布新形象起，我就很期待的。
Content.LocalizedString: AAAAAAAH I've been sooo excited since they announced the new designs.

Content.SourceString: 没想到所谓的新形象……新得像是换了人一样。
Content.LocalizedString: But these "new designs"… they're so new it's like they completely replaced the characters!

Content.SourceString: 那哈尼娅还买这么多是……
Content.LocalizedString: So why is Haniel still buying so many then…?

Content.SourceString: 大概就像《心猎铁骑》一样吧，就算一季比一季烂，还是会有人骂骂咧咧继续买单的。
Content.LocalizedString: It's kinda like "Kokoro Rider", y'know? Even when each season gets worse than the last, people still grumble and pay up anyway.

Content.SourceString: 只要它写着「特工Z世代」这几个字，就会有愚蠢的哈尼娅买单。
Content.LocalizedString: As long as it has "Gen Z" slapped on it, stupid Haniel's gonna buy it anyway.

Content.SourceString: 今晚八点不要忘了，就交给你了鉴定师！
Content.LocalizedString: Don't forget! 8 tonight! I'm counting on u!
I don't have anything going on right now.

Content.SourceString: 在帮阿德勒先生整理仓库。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm helping Adler organize his warehouse.

Content.SourceString: 欸？我还想问你要不要去兜风呢。
Content.LocalizedString: Eh? I was just about to ask if u wanted to go for a joyride!

Content.SourceString: 我还有五分钟就能到伊波恩了。
Content.LocalizedString: I'll be at Eibon in five mins!

Content.SourceString: 远远地都能看到伊波恩了。
Content.LocalizedString: I can see Eibon from here already!
Did Haniel get a new bike?

Content.SourceString: 新车？没有啊，鉴定师怎么这么说？
Content.LocalizedString: New bike? I don't have one lol. Why would u think that?

Content.SourceString: 哈尼娅的车……可以载人吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Haniel's bike… can it even carry passengers?

Content.SourceString: 原计划里我应该很帅气地说出这句话的……
Content.LocalizedString: I was supposed to say that way cooler in my head…

Content.SourceString: 对不起鉴定师，我的车不能载两个人……
Content.LocalizedString: My ride can't actually fit two people…
Haniel, you don't need to apologize.

Content.SourceString: 可我今天已经结束工作了，难道要回去发呆吗……
Content.LocalizedString: But I'm already done with work today, am I just supposed to go home and stare at the ceiling or what…

Content.SourceString: 要不问问看其他人能不能借一辆？
Content.LocalizedString: Why not ask if you can borrow a ride from someone else?
How about I give you a ride instead, Haniel?

Content.SourceString: 我可以租一辆，也很方便。
Content.LocalizedString: I can rent one. It's convenient too.

Content.SourceString: 那不如直接问问哈索尔，我好早就想试试哈索尔的机车了！
Content.LocalizedString: Why don't we just ask Hathor then? I've been dying to try out her motorcycle forever!

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师买了新车吗？我是第一个试乘的人吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Did u get a new ride? Am I gonna be ur first passenger?

Content.SourceString: 可以和鉴定师一起出去玩了吗？

Content.LocalizedString: It's gonna be SUPER cool! I'm heading over rn!

OptionText.LocalizedString: Where would you like to go?

Content.LocalizedString: I'll be at Eibon in a sec!

OptionText.LocalizedString: Where would you like to go?

Content.SourceString: 既然是我先邀请，租车的钱我来出吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Since I invited u first, I'll cover the rent!

OptionText.LocalizedString: Where would you like to go?

Content.SourceString: 哈尼娅想好要去哪里兜风了吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Haniel, have you decided where you want to go for our ride?
Hehe, I've already got it all planned out.
Let's go to the Coastal Highway!

Content.SourceString: 围绕整个桥间地骑一圈！
Content.LocalizedString: Let's ride all the way around Bridge Crossings!

Content.SourceString: 我已经到伊波恩门口了。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm at the entrance of Eibon now!

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，我们一起去兜风吧！
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, let's go for a ride together!

OptionText.LocalizedString: What's with the strange way of speaking?

Content.LocalizedString: It's a strange way to cut sentences off.

Content.SourceString: 哈尼娅你可能是手机中病毒了。
Content.LocalizedString: I think your phone just caught a virus, Haniel.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师要一起去拍卖会吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Wanna come to the auction with us?
I'm afraid I must decline if it's an auction invitation.

Content.SourceString: 这次的邀请函有着落了吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Have we secured an invitation for this time?

Content.SourceString: 恐怕最近都不太想去拍卖会了。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm afraid I haven't been keen on attending auctions lately.

Content.SourceString: 不会又找麦拷贝复制一份吧……
Content.LocalizedString: Don't tell me we're getting Michael Pay to forge another one…

Content.SourceString: 安啦安啦，就是一场很普通的拍卖会，完全比不上惠比寿拍卖会那个级别的。
Content.LocalizedString: Chill, chill! It's just a super normal auction, nowhere near the level of those fancy Ebisu auctions.

Content.SourceString: 连异象拍品都很少，反倒是一些奇奇怪怪的东西很多。
Content.LocalizedString: There r barely any anomaly items up for auction, but loads of weird random stuff instead.

Content.SourceString: 像什么神圣几何体，卡在石头里的剑什么的。
Content.LocalizedString: Like sacred geometry stuff, swords stuck in stones, that kinda thing.

Content.SourceString: 听起来就很有意思，鉴定师一起来玩吧！
Content.LocalizedString: Sounds super fun! Come play with us!

Content.SourceString: 哈尼娅是有什么想买的东西吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Is there something you're looking to buy, Haniel?

Content.SourceString: 是侦探问道漫画登场一周年的特别纪念款耳机，好几年前就停售了。
Content.LocalizedString: It's a special 1st anniversary edition headset for Case in Point, discontinued like years ago.

Content.SourceString: 我在二手市场蹲守了几年才听到这款耳机的消息，据说还是编号111的那个！
Content.LocalizedString: I've been lurking in secondhand markets for years waiting for news about this headset, and they say it's number 111 too!

Content.SourceString: 我还特地找九原姐预支了下个月的工资，这次一定要拿下！
Content.LocalizedString: I even got an advance on next month's salary from Jiuyuan! This time I'm definitely getting it!

OptionText.SourceString: 哈尼娅还真是喜欢耳机啊。
OptionText.LocalizedString: You really love headsets, don't you, Haniel?

Content.SourceString: 哈尼娅还真是喜欢耳机啊。
Content.LocalizedString: You really love headsets, don't you, Haniel?

Content.SourceString: 除了很有意思的拍品之外，这场拍卖会的厨师可是白贝壳三星主厨！
Content.LocalizedString: And besides all the cool auction items, the chef for this event is a La Palourde Blanche chef! 3 stars!

Content.SourceString: 光是点心就值得去看看了，免费不限量供应哦！
Content.LocalizedString: The desserts alone r worth checking out! They're free and unlimited!

Content.SourceString: 应该不是「美味炼金术」那位吧……
Content.LocalizedString: It couldn't be the Delichemy chef, could it…

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师居然也知道？这还是斯特利速递才知道的消息呢。
Content.LocalizedString: U know about them too?! That info just dropped through Sterry Express channels.
We have some history, that's all.

Content.SourceString: 不过这位主厨进修回来后，居然会接这种「不入流」的「小孩子过家家」的「玩意」。
Content.LocalizedString: But after all that training abroad, can't believe this chef would take on such a "low-class" "game" like this.

Content.SourceString: 是他以前访谈时候说的啦。
Content.LocalizedString: He said it himself in an interview before.

Content.SourceString: 咳咳，「这种不入流的拍卖会只会玷污我的作品，如果是要玩小孩子过家家的游戏，还是另请高明吧。」
Content.LocalizedString: Ahem… "Such low-class auctions would only taint my creations. If you want someone to play games with, I suggest you look elsewhere."

Content.SourceString: 差点聊忘记了，所以鉴定师要来吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Omg I almost forgot, u coming to the auction?

Content.SourceString: 我就不去了，还有一些事情要做。
Content.LocalizedString: I'll pass. I still have some things I need to take care of.

Content.SourceString: 没关系没关系，我会记得给你带拍卖会的点心。
Content.LocalizedString: No worries, no worries! I'll remember to bring u some desserts from the auction.

Content.SourceString: 虽然这个厨师人不怎么样，但是他做的点心确实很好吃。
Content.LocalizedString: The chef might be a jerk, but his desserts r seriously delicious.

Content.SourceString: <Blue>「附件：究极版绝对绝对绝对机密demo4.0」</>

Content.LocalizedString: Please don't tell me there's a 5.0 coming…

Content.SourceString: 这是我为下一次「月亮狗之夜」准备的曲子。
Content.LocalizedString: This is the track I prepared for the next Night of Moondog!

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师稍等一下，我又有新灵感了！
Content.LocalizedString: Wait up! I just got another flash of inspiration!

Content.SourceString: <Blue>「附件：月亮狗之夜预定冠军曲终极版demo」</>
（已下载附件：月亮狗之夜预定冠军曲终极版demo）
比起上一次，还算是有进步。
Content.LocalizedString: It's definitely an improvement over your last attempt.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，你就不要安慰我了。

Content.LocalizedString: I guess I just don't have any talent for making music…

Content.SourceString: 我觉得上一次月亮狗之夜，你的表现已经很好了。
Content.LocalizedString: I think you did really well at the last Night of Moondog.

Content.SourceString: 而且就作曲这方面，大家都能看到你的进步。
Content.LocalizedString: And when it comes to composing, everyone can see how much you've improved.

Content.SourceString: <Blue>「附件：月亮狗之夜预定冠军曲终极版歌词」</>
虽然我没有灰心，但是你的安慰我收到了！
Content.LocalizedString: I'm not discouraged or anything, but I still appreciate ur encouragement!

Content.SourceString: 既然如此，鉴定师快看看我新写的歌词！
Content.LocalizedString: If that's the case, check out my new lyrics!

Content.SourceString: （已下载附件：月亮狗之夜预定冠军曲终极版歌词）

Content.LocalizedString: Let me take a closer look…

Content.SourceString: 哼哼我就知道，一切都难不倒天才音乐少女哈尼娅！
Content.LocalizedString: Hehe I knew it! Nothing can stump Haniel the musical genius!

Content.SourceString: 下一次月亮狗之夜，「猫头音！！！！」绝对会拿下最高分的！
Content.LocalizedString: At the next Night of Moondog, The Whoots!!!! are totally gonna get the highest score!

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，和我们组一辈子乐队吧！
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, let's be band friends for life!

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师在吗在吗！红色警报！紧急求援！
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser! You here? You here?! Red alert! Emergency backup needed!

Content.SourceString: 遇到危险了吗？你在哪里？
Content.LocalizedString: Are you in danger? Where are you?

Content.SourceString: 咳咳，其实也不是什么大事啦……但是真的真的很紧急！鉴定师，你懂不懂香水？
Content.LocalizedString: Ahem, well it's not really a big deal… but it's really, really urgent! Appraiser, do you know anything about perfume?

Content.SourceString: 哈尼娅把九原姐新买的香水摔碎了，她一个死宅不懂这些，现在满世界病急乱投yisf@#^
Content.LocalizedString: Haniel broke Jiuyuan's newly bought perfume. Because she's a total nerd, she doesn't understand these things, so now she's desperately asking everyone for hel@#$%

Content.SourceString: 刚刚是伊里卡那家伙抢我手机！现在我抢回来了，鉴定师你别听他乱说！
Content.LocalizedString: Illica grabbed my phone just now! Now I grabbed it back, so Appraiser, don't listen to whatever nonsense he tells you!

Content.SourceString: 简单说就是，我得在九原姐发现前，买一瓶一模一样的香水放回去。问题是香水瓶上没贴标签，我根本认不出来是哪个牌子的……
Content.LocalizedString: Basically, I need to buy an identical bottle of perfume and put it back before Jiuyuan finds out. The problem is there's no label on the perfume bottle, so I can't tell what brand it is at all…

OptionText.LocalizedString: I don't really know much about that either…
Just admit your mistake and apologize.

Content.SourceString: 抱歉，我也不是很了解这类奢侈品，可能没法帮到你。
Content.LocalizedString: Sorry, I don't really know much about luxury items like that either, so I probably can't help you.

Content.SourceString: 还是直接和九原小姐坦白，好好道个歉吧。认错态度好一些，她应该也不会太为难你。
Content.LocalizedString: It's better to just be honest with Jiuyuan and give her a proper apology. If you have a good attitude when admitting your mistake, she probably won't be too hard on you.

Content.SourceString: 我也想过直接道歉，可是万一……万一九原姐生气了呢？她生气可是很吓人的，我不想再见识第二次了呜呜……
Content.LocalizedString: I thought about just apologizing too, but what if… what if Jiuyuan gets angry? When she gets angry, it's really scary! I don't want to go through that again, waaah…

Content.SourceString: 拜托了鉴定师！多一个人多一份力，说不定正好就是你认识的牌子呢！
Content.LocalizedString: Please! I'm begging u! Two heads are better than one, and maybe it'll turn out to be a brand you know!

Content.SourceString: 你是我认识的最可靠的朋友，我真的想不到还能求助谁了……
Content.LocalizedString: You're the most reliable friend I know, and I really can't think of anyone else to turn to…

OptionText.LocalizedString: You better make it up to me.

Content.SourceString: 好吧，那我也来帮忙。虽然可能帮不上什么……
Content.LocalizedString: Alright, I'll help you out too. Though I might not be much help…

Content.SourceString: 好吧，之后记得请我吃饭。
Content.LocalizedString: Alright, just remember to treat me to dinner afterwards.

Content.SourceString: 太好了！鉴定师，我就知道你不会抛弃我！
Content.LocalizedString: Nice! Appraiser, I knew you wouldn't abandon me!
We'll be waiting for you in Sterry!
We'll be waiting for you in Sterry!
